citation_label: ARSD Chapter 67:12:14 Optional State Supplemental Program 1
heading: Definitions.

metadata.title: ARSD Chapter 67:12:14 Optional State Supplemental Program

body:
A person must meet all the following criteria to be eligible to receive benefits under the optional state supplemental program:

(1) The person is receiving SSI and may be receiving in-kind income;

(2) The person is an adult of at least 18 years of age and not in school;

(3) The person is a resident of South Dakota; and

(4) The person has independent living arrangements, such as a home, apartment, hotel room, or room in a boarding house, or resides in the household of another who provides in-kind support or maintenance. Institutionalized individuals or couples living in adult foster care or assisted living arrangements are not eligible.

Source: 5 SDR 6, effective August 6, 1978; 7 SDR 66, 7 SDR 89, effective July 1, 1981; 20 SDR 92, effective December 31, 1993.

General Authority: SDCL 28-1-50.

Law Implemented: SDCL 28-5A-1 , 28-1-49.

body:
Persons eligible for the state optional supplemental program shall receive benefits at a rate approved by the department based on the annual appropriation by the state Legislature. The first payment shall be made in the month the department receives notification from the Social Security Administration that a person is currently receiving SSI payments and meets the eligibility requirements of Â§ 67:12:14:02. Optional supplemental benefits may be paid retroactive to the month of initial SSI eligibility if the client is otherwise eligible, but no retroactive payment may be made for any month prior to the first month of the current state fiscal year.

Source: 5 SDR 6, effective August 6, 1978; 7 SDR 66, 7 SDR 89, effective July 1, 1981; 8 SDR 125, effective April 4, 1982.

General Authority: SDCL 28-1-50.

Law Implemented: SDCL 28-5A-1 , 28-1-49.

body:
In the event a recipient of benefits under this chapter dies after midnight of the first day of the month in which the recipient was eligible to receive an optional supplemental payment, the department shall make arrangements that the final optional supplemental payment shall be paid directly to the deceased recipient's personal representative.

Source: 5 SDR 6, effective August 6, 1978; 7 SDR 66, 7 SDR 89, effective July 1, 1981.

General Authority: SDCL 28-1-50.

Law Implemented: SDCL 28-5A-1 , 28-1-49.

body:
A departmental determination of a client's eligibility for retroactive payment of benefits under this chapter shall be made whenever such a determination is requested by a client. The department and client shall be jointly responsible for the development of facts needed to establish retroactive eligibility. No retroactive payment may be made for any month prior to the first month of the current state fiscal year.

Source: 5 SDR 6, effective August 6, 1978; 7 SDR 66, 7 SDR 89, effective July 1, 1981; 9 SDR 42, effective October 10, 1982.

General Authority: SDCL 28-1-50.

Law Implemented: SDCL 28-5A-1 , 28-1-49.

Source: 7 SDR 23, effective September 18, 1980; 7 SDR 66, 7 SDR 89, effective July 1, 1981.

body:
The department shall suspend a person appealing an SSI decision to close the person's case from the optional supplement program. When SSI eligibility is reestablished, the person may request retroactive optional supplemental payments from the department. Retroactive payments will date back to the time of suspension if the suspension is within the current state fiscal year. No retroactive payment may be made for any month before the first month of the current state fiscal year.

Source: 9 SDR 42, effective October 10, 1982.

General Authority: SDCL 28-1-50.

Law Implemented: SDCL 28-1-49.
